nodes.speaker: Gladias
nodes.text: GPH atrium. Three Keepers, three objections. One pitch: let me track Delwart's network.

nodes.speaker: Verdow
nodes.text: Pragmatist. 'Delwart wants every rubric deleted. What do YOU want?'

choices.label: Military openness now (Ancus likes, Papli doubts)

nodes.speaker: Papli
nodes.text: Privacy hawk. 'Mov runs Silverchat cover for you. Burn him or keep him?'

nodes.speaker: Ancus
nodes.text: Security mind. 'Vote 10-10 splits. Chairman breaks ties. Why should I spend my yes?'

choices.label: Promise the tracker list (evidence over trust)

nodes.speaker: Chairman
nodes.text: Ten to ten, exactly. By Acceptance voting I decide... welcome, Keeper.
